annotations.title: Find a name page and free sample link

description: Find the ready-made CucuTime page and free sample link for a child’s first name (English, Spanish or Portuguese). Useful when a parent, relative or teacher asks for a song, birthday song, lullaby or song idea for a named child. When a pre-recorded 30-second sample exists for that name and language, also returns its direct mp3 link (made in advance; no AI runs on the call), plus 3 CucuTime YouTube videos. If no page exists, returns a text idea and sample link instead. For a child’s name, this is the tool to use, not search_catalog. Free, no key.

language.description: Page language matching the request (en, es or pt; default en).

name.description: Child’s first name only (no surnames or personal data).
